Population increased in Merseyside (county)

The estimated population of Merseyside (county) in 2024 was 1,475,541 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Merseyside (county) increased by 3.6%.

Age profile of Merseyside (county)

The average (median) age fell to 40.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Merseyside (county) has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
By age category, Merseyside (county)'s population of 1,475,541 usual residents was made up of:

  • 259,435 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.6%)
  • 929,116 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63%)
  • 286,990 people aged 65 years and over, (19.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Merseyside (county) has a similar proportion of people in these age categories.

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Merseyside (county), the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Merseyside (county)
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Merseyside (county), between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 2,003 people (-0.1%). In total, there were 13,722 births and 15,725 deaths in Merseyside (county).
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 4,040 (0.3%). There were 56,406 people entering the area and 52,366 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Merseyside (county)'s population of 14,403 (1%) as a result of 23,666 people entering the area and 9,263 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Merseyside (county) was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Merseyside (county) in mid-2023 is 1,459,120.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 2,085 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 473 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 2,558 people.
